facts.scope_summary: Implement Google's Silicon Customer Owned Tooling (COT) supply chain across SAP S/4HANA, Kinaxis, and E2Open to move from a black-box silicon supply chain to end-to-end manufacturing traceability, planning, and collaboration. Scope includes phased delivery of manufacturing visibility, business go-live, expanded analytical capability, integrations, and organizational change management.

out_of_scope: CO/FICO configuration owned by Google internal team
Material valuation, costing, yield accounting, TMS, EWM and Commercial Invoice APIs are either handled by Corp Eng/ASCII or completely out of scope for Bristlecone

WMS/TMS only if confirmed in scope
assumptions: Material valuation, costing, yield accounting, TMS, EWM and Commercial Invoice APIs are either handled by Corp Eng/ASCII or are completely out of scope for Bristlecone.
BOM explosion owned by PLM sharing GPNs/BOMs with CM partners can largely be leveraged from present instance SAP and consumed by Kinaxis.
TSMC PO capability must be live by Dec 4; 22-week fab runway bounds upstream readiness.
Google owns WIP after probe completion at TSMC only, not before; ownership transfers at goods receipt (Google to confirm).
All Phase 1 and Phase 2 manufacturing steps occur within Taiwan; no international mid-stream flows until Phase 3.
Kinaxis workbooks shall be recreated on the new instance with the existing references.
Inventory POs issued to TSMC and UMTC for wafer and substrate procurement; subcontracting POs issued to OSATs for all transformation steps.
Silicon Data Hub is system of record for unit-level test data and yield inputs into Kinaxis.
Manufacturing strategy is Make-to-Stock through die bank and Make-to-Order from die bank to finished goods.
Lot genealogy and yield capture will reside in E2Open and the Silicon Data Hub, not SAP.
UMTC substrate has an 18-week lead time and a substrate PO may need to be cut before Kinaxis is live.
Yield and MLS functionalities shall be a new configuration.
Preferred to retain Google's existing integration framework used for machines planning.
Existing integrations will be leveraged and incremental delta interfaces will be in scope, subject to discovery analysis.
Subcontracting PO model: Google issues components to OSAT, OSAT transforms, Google receives finished part.
Schedule agreements for high-volume/rolling TSMC wafer orders, not individual POs.
All Phase 1/2 manufacturing moves are within Taiwan and managed through SAP/E2Open/GCL assumptions stated in WS5.
Quanta acts as exporter of record for finished goods shipped from Taiwan to Google USA.
Google becomes importer of record for finished goods entering the USA under COT.
GPlan is the primary middleware integrating PLM, SAP, and Kinaxis.
PLM to S/4HANA and Kinaxis to S/4 integrations will use existing GPLAN/SAL API framework and Google internal team will configure.
